attributes.context: This provision appears in Appendix F, after the heading stating that the notes apply to employees in the Police Department only, and is part of a list of department-specific premium wage notes.

extraction_text: K. When an employee in the class of Senior Clerk Typist, Code 1368, who is regularly assigned to the Police Department Records and Identification Division or Information Resources Division, Operations Support Unit, is regularly assigned to operate a remote data entry and recall system (e.g., Video 370 CRT), such employee shall receive salary at the first premium level rate (2.75%) above the appropriate step rate of the salary range for his/her class.

attributes.context: The provision appears in Appendix F as note P among several class- and department-specific premium pay notes, including adjacent notes on salary protection, training, lead assignments, and service request processing.

extraction_text: P. Three employees in the class of Senior Clerk Typist, Code 1368, who are assigned to the Information Resources Division (IRD) and are required to train department personnel in the use of automated systems, each such employee shall receive salary at the second premium level rate (5.5%) above the appropriate step rate of the salary range for the class.
